question: For each instance display name on host blaze8-12 that has system metadata with key 'image_image_type' (and considering only non-deleted instances where applicable), show the minimum instance ID, the per-display-name average memory (MB) and the overall average of those per-display-name averages, and also show the per-display-name average and variance of memory (MB) plus the deviation of each display name’s average memory from the overall average memory across all such instances. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, i.id, i.memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata m
    ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
   AND m.`key` = 'image_image_type'
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
),
per AS (
  SELECT display_name,
         MIN(id) AS min_id,
         AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_mem,
         VAR_SAMP(memory_mb) AS var_mem
  FROM base
  GROUP BY display_name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_mem) AS overall_avg
  FROM per
)
SELECT p.display_name,
       p.min_id,
       p.avg_mem,
       o.overall_avg,
       p.var_mem,
       p.avg_mem - o.overall_avg AS deviation
FROM per p
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY p.display_name;
